specification.title: Writing a scholarly paper
specification.outcome: Organize a paper around its question, contribution, evidence and limitations.

genre: Research instruction, with macro-finance primary specialization and financial econometrics supporting field. Teach concrete usable processes through complete original examples, not a checklist alone. Do not represent synthetic demonstrations as original discoveries, actual completed replication or learner achievement.
requirements: Read exact canonical coverage and necessary accepted prerequisites; preserve existing notation. At least two substantial fully worked cases and eight original exercises with full determinate solutions or explicit criteria and illustrative complete open-ended answers. Technical graduate results need all proofs and at least ten exercises if the chapter is technical. Aim concise sufficient prose; do not force five numerical models into a research-writing chapter.

Teach scholarly writing through a complete original compact paper specimen: precise title, abstract, introduction/contribution, methods, results/tables, limitations and appendix; plus a substantive before/after revision case with reasoning. Original transparent synthetic results must not masquerade as real empirical discovery or actual paper submission. Include eight original exercises and complete determinate solutions or explicit rubric plus full illustrative answers. Reader should learn how to write, not merely receive headings.

Reuse bounded primary source inspections honestly; retrieve current specialist/institutional facts and paper contents when needed. Precise source records with original inspector/actual pages and limits. Never imply bibliographic search proves exhaustive novelty or unperformed reproduction. No source problem copying.

HTML fragment without h1; class=worked articles, ol.exercises with IDs, full matched data-solution-for inside details.solutions; teach-back and delayed retention plus answer guides, definitions, units, domains and limitations. Reader-facing state independent of production notes.
